senses.gloss:
Deaf,Ⓒs.ⒹbaDira, Srotravikala, akarRa, eqa; ‘d(eaf) and dumb’ eqamUkaH.
Ⓝ[Deaf]en,Ⓒv. t.ⒹbaDirayati (D.), karRaM upahan 2 P, baDirIkf 8 U; ‘d(eafen)ing all directions with cries of alas’ hAhAninAdenadiSo baDirayaMtaH.
Ⓝ[Deaf]ly,Ⓒadv.ⒹbaDiravat; aSrutipUrvaM.
Ⓝ[Deaf]ness,Ⓒs.ⒹbaDiratA, eqatA, SravaRAkzamatA.

Deal,Ⓒs.ⒹbAhulyaM, prAcuryaM; ‘a good d(eal) of’ bahu, pracura, BUri, vipula; ‘a good d(eal) of corn’ bahuDAnyaM; ‘a good d(eal)’ (adv.) atyaMtaM, bahu, BfSaM, gAQaM, ati or su pr.; sutapta, atikfSa, &c.
Ⓑ
 2 devadAru n.
Ⓔv. t.ⒹviBaj 1 U, parikxp c., pfTak pfTag vinyas 4 U.
Ⓑ
 2 vikF 6 U, vyas 4 P; ‘d(eal) blows’ muzwinA prahf 1 P; AGAtaM-prahAraM-kf 8 U.
Ⓔv. i.Ⓓ(in) paR 1 A, vyApf 6 A; krayavikrayaM kf, vyavahf 1 P; ‘he does not d(eal) in missiles’ nAsya vyavahArostrezu (U. 5).
Ⓝ[Deal] with,ⒶAcar 1 P, vft 1 A, vyavahf.
Ⓑ
 2 pratikf 8 U; niruD 7 U; sparD 1 A; See Contend.
Ⓑ
 3 viDA 3 U, vaSIkf, vinI 1 P; ‘easy to d(eal with)’ viDeyaH, vaSyaH.
Ⓝ[Deal]er,Ⓒs.ⒹvaRij m., ApaRikaH, vipaRin m., krayavikrayin m.
Ⓑ
 2 vyavahArin-vyApArin-vyavasAyin m.; ‘d(ealer) in wood’ kAzWavyavahArakaH.
Ⓝ[Deal]ing,Ⓒs.ⒹvARijyaM, nigamaH, vipaRaH, krayavikrayaH.

Dear,Ⓒa.ⒹbahumUlya, mahArGa-rha, mahAmUlya.
Ⓑ
 2 priya, dayita, vallaBa, aBimata, izwa, kAMta, aBI-psita; ‘d(ear) friend’ hfdayaMgamaH saKA; ‘as d(ear) as oneʼs life’ prARapriyasama.
Ⓑ
 3 (As a term of endearment) dayita, kAMta, jAta, vatsa, priya; ‘d(ear) Jānaki’ priye jAnaki; vatsa rAma, &c.

Ⓑ

Ⓑ

Ⓝ[Dear]ness,Ⓒs.ⒹpriyatA, aBIzwatA, prIti f.
Ⓑ
 2 bahumUlyaM, mahArGatA, mahArGaH.

Dearth,Ⓒs.ⒹdurBikzaM, duzkAlaH; ‘d(earth) felt’ nI-vAkaH, prayAmaH.
